authority: main_implementation plan.md P08.1; api design.md section 3.9
decision: Require an organization_id query parameter, resolve tenant membership server-side and intersect source:manage token scope with the source_operator role. Read the latest durable source probe per catalog distribution inside tenant RLS, with bounded UUID pagination and optional provider filter.
response_boundary: Return catalog and latest probe status, probe time and a safe error code. Never return probe payload, endpoint URL, credentials, raw error text or full evidence. A passed metadata access check is explicitly not a scientific validation claim.
meaning: metadata_access_passed is true only when the latest succeeded probe evidence declares metadata_access_only, matches the pinned version and remains scientifically not_validated. science_validated is false until a separate scientific gate supplies proof.
local_verification: 16 affected HTTP/contract tests passed and one disposable PostgreSQL test verified successful and never-checked distributions plus tenant isolation. No external NOAA access or staging acceptance is claimed.
